items.source: To facilitate the sending of domain model objects, the JmsTemplate has various send methods that take a Java object as an argument for a message’s data content. The overloaded methods convertAndSend() and receiveAndConvert() methods in JmsTemplate delegate the conversion process to an instance of the MessageConverter interface. This interface defines a simple contract to convert between Java objects and JMS messages. The default implementation (SimpleMessageConverter) supports conversion between String and TextMessage, byte[] and BytesMessage, and java.util.Map and MapMessage. By using the converter, you and your application code can focus on the business object that is being sent or received through JMS and not be concerned with the details of how it is represented as a JMS message.
items.translation: 为便于发送领域模型对象，JmsTemplate 提供了多种发送方法，这些方法接受一个 Java 对象作为消息数据内容的参数。JmsTemplate 中的重载方法 convertAndSend() 和 receiveAndConvert() 将转换过程委托给 MessageConverter 接口的实例。该接口定义了简单的契约，用于在 Java 对象和 JMS 消息之间进行转换。默认实现 (SimpleMessageConverter) 支持 String 与 TextMessage、byte[] 与 BytesMessage 以及 java.util.Map 与 MapMessage 之间的转换。通过使用转换器，您和应用程序代码可以专注于通过 JMS 发送或接收的业务对象，而无需关心其作为 JMS 消息表示的细节。

items.source: While the send operations cover many common usage scenarios, you might sometimes want to perform multiple operations on a JMS Session or MessageProducer. The SessionCallback and ProducerCallback expose the JMS Session and Session / MessageProducer pair, respectively. The execute() methods on JmsTemplate run these callback methods.
items.translation: 虽然发送操作涵盖了大多数常见的使用场景，但有时您可能希望在 JMS Session 或 MessageProducer 上执行多个操作。SessionCallback 和 ProducerCallback 分别暴露了 JMS Session 以及 Session /MessageProducer 对。JmsTemplate 上的 execute() 方法会运行这些回调方法。

items.source: In the preceding example, the JmsTemplate is constructed by passing a reference to a ConnectionFactory. As an alternative, a zero-argument constructor and connectionFactory is provided and can be used for constructing the instance in JavaBean style (using a BeanFactory or plain Java code). Alternatively, consider deriving from Spring’s JmsGatewaySupport convenience base class, which provides pre-built bean properties for JMS configuration.
items.translation: 在前面的示例中，JmsTemplate 是通过传递一个 ConnectionFactory 引用构建的。作为替代方案，提供了一个无参构造函数和 connectionFactory 属性，可用于以 JavaBean 风格（使用 BeanFactory 或纯 Java 代码）构建实例。或者，可以考虑继承 Spring 的 JmsGatewaySupport 便捷基类，该类提供了用于 JMS 配置的预建 Bean 属性。

items.source: Applications often need to intercept messages before they are sent out, for example to add message properties to all outgoing messages. The org.springframework.messaging.core.MessagePostProcessor based on the spring-messaging Message can do that, when configured on the JmsClient. It will be used for all outgoing messages sent with the send and sendAndReceive methods.
items.translation: 应用程序通常需要在消息发送之前拦截消息，例如为所有出站消息添加消息属性。基于 spring-messaging 的Message的org.springframework.messaging.core.MessagePostProcessor可以在配置到JmsClient时实现此功能。它将被用于通过send和sendAndReceive方法发送的所有出站消息。

items.source: The JmsTemplate contains many convenience methods to send a message. Send methods specify the destination by using a jakarta.jms.Destination object, and others specify the destination by using a String in a JNDI lookup. The send method that takes no destination argument uses the default destination.
items.translation: JmsTemplate 包含许多用于发送消息的便捷方法。发送方法通过使用 jakarta.jms.Destination 对象指定目标，而其他方法则通过 JNDI 查找使用 String 指定目标。不带目标参数的 send 方法使用默认目标。

items.source: The send(String destinationName, MessageCreator creator) method lets you send a message by using the string name of the destination. If these names are registered in JNDI, you should set the destinationResolver property of the template to an instance of JndiDestinationResolver.
items.translation: `send(String destinationName, MessageCreator creator)` 方法允许您使用目的地的字符串名称发送消息。如果这些名称已注册在 JNDI 中，则应将模板的 `destinationResolver` 属性设置为 `JndiDestinationResolver` 的实例。

items.source: The sandbox currently includes a MapMessageConverter, which uses reflection to convert between a JavaBean and a MapMessage. Other popular implementation choices you might implement yourself are converters that use an existing XML marshalling package (such as JAXB or XStream) to create a TextMessage that represents the object.
items.translation: 沙箱当前包含一个MapMessageConverter，它使用反射在 JavaBean 和MapMessage之间进行转换。您自己实现的其他流行选择是使用现有的 XML 序列化包（例如 JAXB 或 XStream）来创建表示该对象的TextMessage的转换器。

items.source: If you created the JmsTemplate and specified a default destination, the send(MessageCreator c) sends a message to that destination.
items.translation: 如果您创建了 JmsTemplate 并指定了默认目标，则 send(MessageCreator c) 会将消息发送到该目标。

items.source: To accommodate the setting of a message’s properties, headers, and body that can not be generically encapsulated inside a converter class, the MessagePostProcessor interface gives you access to the message after it has been converted but before it is sent.
